# AstroWind

> AstroWind is a free, open-source website template built with Astro and Tailwind CSS, with starter pages and guides for creating and customizing a website.

## Primary

- [AstroWind homepage](https://theggdoula.vercel.app/): Overview of the template, its features, and how to get started.

## Key pages

- [About](https://theggdoula.vercel.app/about): Background and information about AstroWind.
- [Services](https://theggdoula.vercel.app/services): Example service offerings and layouts included with the template.
- [Blog](https://theggdoula.vercel.app/blog): Tutorials and resources about AstroWind, Astro, and website creation.
- [Contact](https://theggdoula.vercel.app/contact): Example contact form and support page.

## Guides

- [Get started with AstroWind](https://theggdoula.vercel.app/get-started-website-with-astro-tailwind-css): Install and configure the template, create a page, and publish a site.
- [Build websites with AI](https://theggdoula.vercel.app/build-websites-with-ai): Use coding assistants with AstroWind's repository guidance and skills.
- [Customize AstroWind to your brand](https://theggdoula.vercel.app/how-to-customize-astrowind-to-your-brand): Update the template's branding, styles, and site content.
- [Useful tools and resources for creating websites](https://theggdoula.vercel.app/useful-resources-to-create-websites): Curated tools and references for planning, building, and maintaining websites.
